name: @untch/receipt-writer
description: Untch receipt writer (PRD §7.4 / §10.3). Consumes preflight_payment decisions from the seller, writes a durable Postgres ledger + receipt row immediately, then batches receipts (N or T) and anchors them to the deployed UntchReceipts on X Layer testnet via BullMQ, with retry/backoff → DEGRADED_UNANCHORED and reorg re-verification. Postgres is the source of truth; chain anchoring is downstream of durability.
